summary: Iteration 33 — verified the two new retreat features (Retreat Photos gallery + Waitlist/auto-promotion) end to end on the external preview URL. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (gallery persist via POST + PATCH /api/admin/workshops, GET /api/retreats/{id}/availability shape + 404, POST /api/retreats/waitlist 400-when-seats-available / 401-unauth / position-1-when-full / idempotent, POST /api/retreats/{res_id}/cancel -> earliest waitlisted auto-promoted to seat_offered, seat_offered bypasses capacity on reserve and clears waitlist/offer rows). Frontend: admin Retreats pane 'Gallery image URLs' textarea publishes a retreat whose gallery persists and renders; WorkshopDetail shows 'The villa & practice' gallery with both unsplash images actually loading (naturalWidth 800), 'Full — join the waitlist' button on a capacity-1 full retreat, POST succeeds and the "You're #1 on the waitlist" note appears and persists across reload, and after an admin cancel the student sees '🎉 A seat opened — reserve now' which opens the reservation form with both PayPal/Stripe buttons. One real bug found: the reserve form no longer prefills the logged-in user's name/email. All TEST_ retreats and their registrations were deleted; only the 4 seeded retreats remain and student@demo.com has no leftover registrations.

ui_bugs.issue: Name and Email inputs are EMPTY for a logged-in user (both the normal Reserve path and the seat_offered claim path). form state is initialised once with user?.name/user?.email while `user` is still null during async auth hydration, and never re-synced, so the user must retype both or beforeReservationCheckout() rejects with 'Name and email required'. Fix: add a useEffect that patches form.name/form.email when `user` resolves (or initialise lazily once user is available).

issues: Start/End date use the native browser date input (type="date") rather than the shadcn calendar used elsewhere — inconsistent with the design system (pre-existing, not part of this task)
Retreat delete uses window.confirm() native dialog instead of an in-app AlertDialog (pre-existing)

action_items: Prefill WorkshopDetail reserve form name/email from the auth user once it hydrates (useEffect on `user`) — currently blank for logged-in students.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/retreats.py: `_logger` is defined at the bottom of the module but referenced inside _promote_waitlist's except blocks — fine at runtime (module-level binding exists by call time) but fragile; move the logger to the top of the file.
join_waitlist returns 200 with the existing row when the user already has a reservation/waitlist entry — the frontend treats that as success; acceptable but a 409 would be more explicit.

server.py CORS: allow_credentials=False with allow_origins default '*' while login also sets an httpOnly cookie — the cookie is unusable cross-origin by design (app uses Bearer token); consider explicit origins + credentials if cookie auth is ever relied upon.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx is ~1864 lines — should be split into per-pane modules (>700 line guideline).

rca_of_the_issue: Prefill bug: WorkshopDetail initialises useState({name: user?.name, email: user?.email}) on first render; the auth context resolves the user asynchronously after that render, and there is no effect syncing the form, so the fields stay empty.
